description: Defines the 'WifiManagerState' class with methods related to WiFi management state operations, including retrieving current state, connected SSID, and enabling/disabling WiFi.

classes.name: WifiManagerState
classes.description: Class providing WiFi manager state interface, including methods to get current WiFi state, connected SSID, and enable/disable WiFi.

methods.name: getCurrentState
methods.description: Retrieves the current WiFi state based on provided JSON parameters.

methods.name: getConnectedSSID
methods.description: Retrieves the SSID of the currently connected WiFi network.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables WiFi based on input parameters.
